raw.text: WATERTOWN, Mass., Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Kymera Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ: KYMR), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company advancing a new class of oral small molecule degrader medicines for immunological diseases, today announced the pricing of its underwritten public offering of $1.75 billion of shares of its common stock. Kymera is selling 11,638,000 shares of common stock in the offering, which are being sold at a public offering price of $150.37 per share. In addition, Kymera has granted the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 1,745,700 shares of its common stock at the public offering price per share, less underwriting discounts and commissions. The gross proceeds to Kymera from the offering are expected to be approximately $1.75 billion, before deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and estimated offering expenses payable by Kymera, assuming no exercise of the underwriters' option to purchase additional shares. All of the securities being sold in this offering are being offered by Kymera. The offering is expected to close on November 25, 2026, subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions.

raw.title: Belite Bio Announces Extension of FDA Review Timeline for Tinlarebant NDA
raw.text: SAN DIEGO, Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Belite Bio, Inc (NASDAQ: BLTE) (“Belite Bio®” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage drug development company focused on advancing novel therapeutics targeting degenerative retinal diseases that have significant unmet medical needs, today announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has informed the Company that (i) it has extended the review period for the New Drug Application (NDA) for tinlarebant for the treatment of Stargardt disease type 1 (STGD1) by three months, with the extended Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) action date being May 12, 2027, and (ii) if no major deficiencies are identified during FDA's ongoing review, the FDA plans to communicate proposed labeling requests and any anticipated postmarketing requirement requests, if necessary, with the Company by April 12, 2027. The extension provides the FDA with additional time to review information provided in support of the NDA.

raw.title: Still Avoiding Canadian Pacific Kansas City
raw.text: I continue to avoid Canadian Pacific Kansas City Limited: its $31 billion Kansas City Southern acquisition looks excessive, and the shares demand too much optimism. Despite merger synergies, CP's revenue rose 8.3%, while net income fell 9%; nearly $2 billion in new debt compounds the risk. CP's dividend would need to grow about 37% annually for a decade to match the cash from a 10-year Treasury Note.

raw.text: NEW HAVEN, Conn., Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Invivyd, Inc. (Nasdaq: IVVD) today announced all interim analysis primary and secondary endpoints were met in the DECLARATION Phase 3 trial of VYD2311 (ibramvibart). VYD2311, administered via intramuscular injection (IM), demonstrated high and durable antiviral activity, consistent with Invivyd's target 70-90% protection from RT-PCR confirmed symptomatic COVID-19, versus placebo. VYD2311 demonstrated an overall highly attractive safety and tolerability profile in both single- and multi-dose arms. Invivyd intends to submit a Biologics License Application (BLA) seeking accelerated approval of VYD2311 for the prevention of symptomatic COVID-19 based on the positive interim analysis of the Phase 3 DECLARATION trial and the supportive data from the Phase 3 LIBERTY trial comparing VYD2311 and an mRNA-based COVID-19 vaccine.

raw.title: Tiziana Life Sciences Files Updated Foralumab Annual Safety Report with FDA Confirming Favorable Safety and Tolerability Profile
raw.text: BOSTON, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Tiziana Life Sciences, Ltd. (Nasdaq: TLSA) (“Tiziana” or the “Company”), a biotechnology company developing breakthrough immunomodulation therapies with its lead development candidate, intranasal foralumab, a fully human anti-CD3 monoclonal antibody, today announced the submission of its annual Development Safety Update Report (DSUR) to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA). This DSUR (dated September 2, 2024 to September 30, 2026) reports no drug-related serious adverse events after a cumulative exposure of 48.1 patient-years, highlighting the safety and tolerability data profile of intranasal foralumab in treating neuroinflammatory and neurodegenerative diseases, including non-active secondary progressive multiple sclerosis (na-SPMS), Alzheimer's disease (AD), multiple system atrophy (MSA), and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS).

raw.text: VALENCIA, Spain, Nov. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Turbo Energy, S.A. (Nasdaq: TURB) (“Turbo Energy” or the “Company”), a global technology integrator specializing in AI-driven storage and energy management solutions, today announced that it received a notification letter (the “Notice”) from the Listing Qualifications Department of The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC (“Nasdaq”) dated November 20, 2026, indicating that the Company is not in compliance with the minimum bid price requirement for continued listing on the Nasdaq Capital Market under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2), which requires listed securities to maintain a minimum bid price of $1.00 per share. Nasdaq Listing Rule 5810(c)(3)(A) provides that a failure to meet the minimum bid price requirement exists if the deficiency continues for a period of 30 consecutive business days. This press release is issued pursuant to Nasdaq Listing Rule 5810(b), which requires prompt disclosure upon receipt of a deficiency notification.

raw.text: WASHINGTON, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- 60 Degree Pharmaceuticals, Inc. ("Inverite") (CSE: INVR) (OTC: INVRF) (FSE: 2V0), a Canadian risk infrastructure company providing real-time financial data and decisioning signals, specializing in real-time bank verification, income and affordability analytics, and AI-driven risk-modeling and fraud-prevention solutions used by fintechs, lenders, and financial institutions across Canada, today welcomed the Government of Canada's designation of Financial Data Exchange ("FDX") as the technical standards body and the Ombudsman for Banking Services and Investments ("OBSI") as the external complaints body under Canada's Consumer-Driven Banking Framework, as announced by the Department of Finance Canada on November 20, 2026. The designations were announced by the Honourable François-Philippe Champagne, Minister of Finance and National Revenue, and the ministerial orders were published in Canada Gazette, Part I. FDX will develop and maintain the technical standard for secure, interoperable data sharing between participating entities, including common data definitions and protocols for secure communication. Under a made-in-Canada approach, FDX has established a Canada Council that can make decisions independently of the broader FDX Board, with voting membership limited to Canadian residents and businesses. OBSI, designated in 2023 as the sole external complaints body for banks, will independently investigate consumer-driven banking complaints that participating entities have not resolved and recommend resolutions.

raw.title: The 10 Most Profitable REITs
raw.text: REIT profitability metrics are a useful baseline, but business models and accounting subtleties demand company-specific analysis. Triple-net leases boost property-level margins, but interest expense can erode company-level profitability; low leverage and efficient corporate overhead support FFO margins. NOI relative to gross depreciable property generally offers the clearest view of asset profitability, though land holdings and accounting resets can distort it.

raw.title: Dycom Announces Authorization of a New $200 Million Stock Repurchase Program
raw.text: WEST PALM BEACH, Fla., Nov. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Dycom Industries, Inc. (NYSE: DY) today announced that its Board of Directors has authorized a new $200 million program to repurchase shares of Dycom's outstanding common stock. Repurchases under the new program are authorized to be made over the next eighteen (18) months in open market purchases or privately-negotiated transactions, including pursuant to a Rule 10b5-1 plan. The exact timing and amount of repurchases, if any, will depend on market conditions and other factors. The repurchase program does not obligate Dycom to acquire any particular amount of common stock, and may be suspended or discontinued at any time. The new program replaces the Company's previous $150 million stock repurchase program of which approximately $49.5 million remained outstanding. As of November 20, 2026, the Company had 29,821,320 shares of common stock outstanding, excluding the dilutive effect of stock options and unvested restricted stock.

raw.text: SINGAPORE, Nov. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Noah Holdings Limited ("Noah" or the "Company") (NYSE: NOAH and HKEX: 6686), a leading and pioneer wealth management service provider offering comprehensive one-stop advisory services on global investment and asset allocation primarily for global Chinese high-net-worth investors, today announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2026. raw.text: TORONTO, ONTARIO – TheNewswire - November 24, 2026 – AEON STRATEGIES LTD. (formerly Cloud3 Ventures Inc.) (CSE: AEON) (OTCQB: CLDVF) (FSE: WQ40) (the “ Company ” or “ Aeon ”) is providing this bi-weekly default status report, further to its news release dated November 10, 2026, under National Policy 12-203 – Management Cease Trade Orders (“ NP 12-203 ”). On October 23, 2026 and October 27, 2026, the Company announced that it expected to be unable to file its audited annual financial statements for the year ended June 30, 2026, the related management's discussion and analysis and the related CEO and CFO certifications (collectively, the “ Annual Filings ”) by the October 28, 2026 filing deadline.   On October 29, 2026, the Ontario Securities Commission, as principal regulator, issued a management cease trade order (the “ MCTO ”) under NP 12-203. The MCTO prohibits the Company's Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer from trading in or acquiring the Company's securities, directly or indirectly. It will remain in effect until two full business days after the Ontario Securities Commission receives all filings the Company is required to make under Ontario securities law, or until further order. The MCTO does not affect the ability of other shareholders to trade in the Company's securities.

(NYSE American: OGEN) (“Oragenics” or the “Company”), a biotech company advancing innovative treatments for brain-related health conditions, today announced that its Board of Directors (the “Board”) on November 25, 2026 approved a One-for-Six and One-Half (1-for-6.5) reverse stock split of the Company's issued and outstanding shares of common stock, par value $0.001 per share (the “Reverse Stock Split”). As a result of the Reverse Stock Split, the Company's common stock is expected to begin trading on the NYSE American on a split-adjusted basis when the markets open on December 7, 2026, subject to NYSE American approval, including of any required supplemental listing application.

raw.title: The Precision Peptide Company Sends 40,000 Needle-Free Weight-Management Patches Into U.S. Production as Tirzepatide and GLP3 Clear Testing
raw.text: Tirzepatide and GLP3 become the third and fourth patches in the Company's needle-free line to reach production, 100% tested and manufactured in the United States by a single manufacturer producing exclusively for the Company; full lineup targeted for sale by Q1 2027 Highlights 20,000 tirzepatide and 20,000 GLP3 patches ordered after both passed formal U.S. testing, the third and fourth patches in the Company's needle-free line to reach a commercial production order The Recovery Patch (BPC-157) is on sale now; 20,000 Thymosin Alpha-1 patches ordered for January 2027 delivery; tirzepatide and GLP3 ordered today; full needle-free lineup targeted for sale by Q1 2027 Both are GLP-1 category patches, aimed at a global GLP-1 market valued at approximately US$66 billion in 2025 and projected to reach US$185.3 billion by 2033[2,3] 100% tested and manufactured in the United States, by one U.S. manufacturer, with every patch produced solely for the Company under exclusive manufacturing rights No needle, no mixing, no measuring, no refrigeration Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - The Precision Peptide Company (CSE: BPC) (OTCQB: PNGAF) (the "Company"), a publicly traded wellness company focused on advanced peptide formulations and delivery systems, today announced that its tirzepatide and GLP3 transdermal patches have each passed formal U.S. testing and that it has ordered 20,000 units of each from its exclusive U.S. manufacturer. They are the third and fourth patches in the Company's needle-free line to reach a commercial production order, following BPC-157 and Thymosin Alpha-1, and the Company is targeting a full needle-free lineup on sale by the first quarter of 2027, up from the single patch on sale today.

raw.title: Pinnacle Silver and Gold reports final Pinos Cuates assays from Mexico drill program
raw.text: Pinnacle Silver & Gold Corp (TSX-V:PINN, OTCQB:PSGCF) reported the remaining assay results from underground delineation drilling at the Pinos Cuates mine at its Potrero property in Durango, Mexico, including true widths of up to 5.75 metres, the company said.  The Pinos Cuates program comprised 1,452 metres in 73 holes as part of a 108-hole program centred on three historic mines.

raw.title: Pinnacle Further Defines High-Grade Mineralization at El Potrero with True Widths of 4.33 metres of 7.18 g/t Au and 165 g/t Ag and 5.75 metres of 4.38 g/t Au and 57 g/t Ag
raw.text: VANCOUVER, BRITISH COLUMBIA – TheNewswire - November 26, 2026 (TSXV: PINN, OTCQB: PSGCF, Frankfurt: P9J) – Pinnacle Silver and Gold Corp. (" Pinnacle " or the “ Company ") is pleased to announce the remainder of assay results from the underground delineation drilling program at the historic Pinos Cuates mine at the Potrero property in Durango, Mexico (see Figures 1 and 2).  The drilling at Pinos Cuates comprised 1,452.20 metres in 73 holes as part of a larger 108-hole program centered on the three historic mines.  In addition, results from the smaller La Dura mine and initial holes at the Dos de Mayo mine are reported.  Not only do the results continue to display the high-grade nature of gold-silver mineralization but true widths up to 5.75 metres are now being demonstrated. raw.title: Safe-haven stocks dominate the risers as London traders go into risk-off mode

As mentioned in the Company's news release on October 14, 2026, forty-six spot samples from four archived drill holes at the Earth Analysis Research Library of the Kentucky Geological Survey in Lexington, Kentucky, were analyzed by inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry ("ICP-MS").

raw.title: Moleculin Reports 32% Blinded Remission Rate in Post-Venetoclax AML Subjects in Pivotal MIRACLE Trial; Randomized Results On Track for First Quarter of 2027
raw.text: HOUSTON, Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Moleculin Biotech, Inc. (Nasdaq: MBRX) (“Moleculin” or the “Company”) today reported preliminary blinded results from all 90 subjects in Part A of its pivotal Phase 2/3 MIRACLE trial (MB-108) of Annamycin (also known as naxtarubicin) in combination with cytarabine (AnnAraC) for the treatment of relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (R/R AML). Among the 47 subjects who entered the trial after relapsing from or having been refractory to treatment with a venetoclax-containing (post-venetoclax) regimen, the preliminary blinded composite complete remission (CRc) rate after a single cycle of therapy was 32% (15 of 47). CRc includes complete remission (CR), CR with incomplete hematologic recovery (CRi) and CR with partial hematologic recovery (CRh). Moleculin knows of no other randomized controlled trial to date that has reported results in post-venetoclax patients. Additionally, the unblinding of subject-level Part A results, which is on track for the first quarter of 2027, will compare each of the two Annamycin doses versus a concurrent control arm in this population.

raw.text: Erste Bohrungen in der Purdex-Zone abgeschlossen: In der Purdex-Zone auf dem zu 100 % unternehmenseigenen Goldgrundstück „High Lake" wurden vier Diamantbohrlöcher mit einer Gesamtlänge von 1. 718,5 Metern fertiggestellt. raw.title: Laurion Announces Proposed Private Placement of Flow-Through Units
raw.text: TORONTO, ONTARIO – TheNewswire - November 25 , 2026 – LAURION Mineral Exploration Inc. (TSX.V: LME|OTC: LMEFF|FSE: 5YD) (“LAURION” or the “Corporation”) today announced that it is proposing to complete a flow-through private placement on a non-brokered basis (the “ Private Placement ”). The Corporation intends to raise up to approximately $ 1.5 million in gross proceeds by issuing up to approximately 14,285,714 “flow through” units (“ FT Units ”) at a price of $0.105 per FT Unit. Each FT Unit will consist of one common share of the Corporation to be issued as a “flow-through share” (as defined in subsection 66(15) of the Income Tax Act (Canada) (the “ Tax Act ”)) and one-half of one common share purchase warrant (each whole warrant, a “ Warrant ”). Each Warrant will entitle the holder thereof to acquire one non flow-through common share of the Corporation at a price of $0.18 per share for a period of 24 months from the date of issuance.

(TSXV: ZAC | OTCQB: ZCTSF | FRA: 7TV) (“Zacatecas Silver” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce that it has closed the option agreement dated October 5, 2026, as amended November 20, 2026, (the “Agreement”) with Guanajuato Silver Company Ltd. (TSXV: GSVR) (“Guanajuato Silver”), its subsidiary Mina Bolanitos, S.A. de C.V. raw.title: Arizona Gold & Silver Inc. and Sorbie Bornholm LP agree to Postpone Commencement of Sharing Agreement
raw.text: Vancouver, British Columbia – TheNewswire - November 23, 2026 – Arizona Gold & Silver Inc. (“Arizona” or the “Company”) (TSXV: AZS) (OTCQB: AZASF) is pleased to announce that the Company and Sorbie Bornholm LP (“Sorbie”) have mutually agreed to defer the commencement of the Sharing Agreement. Both parties believe that allowing additional time for market conditions to strengthen before monthly settlements begin is in the best interests of the Company's shareholders. The Sharing Agreement was structured to provide for a measured settlement process based on the 20-day volume-weighted average price (VWAP) each month. Both parties remain confident in the agreement's structure and believe that a stronger market environment will provide a more favorable foundation for its commencement.

raw.title: Bonterra Announces Exercise of Earn-In Right by Gold Fields to Acquire a 70% Interest in the Phoenix JV
raw.text: Val-d'Or, Quebec--(Newsfile Corp. - November 24, 2026) - Bonterra Resources Inc. (TSXV: BTR) (OTCQX: BONXF) (FSE: 9BR2) ("Bonterra" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that Windfall Mining Group Inc. ("WMG"), a wholly owned subsidiary of Gold Fields Limited ("Gold Fields"), has exercised its earn-in right (the "Earn-In Right") in respect of the Urban-Barry properties, including the Barry and Gladiator deposits, located in Québec's Eeyou Istchee James Bay region (the "Properties" or the "Phoenix JV"). The Earn-In Right was granted under the amended and restated earn-in and joint venture shareholders agreement dated June 26, 2024 (the "A&R Earn-In Agreement") among Bonterra, Osisko Mining Inc. ("Osisko") and UB Phoenix Corp. ("UB Phoenix"), as further described in the Company's news release dated November 28, 2023 and entitled "Bonterra Executes Definitive Option Agreement with Osisko Mining on Bonterra's Urban-Barry Property".

raw.title: Laurion Announces Proposed Private Placement of Flow-Through Units
raw.text: TORONTO, ONTARIO – TheNewswire - November 25 , 2026 – LAURION Mineral Exploration Inc. (TSX.V: LME|OTC: LMEFF|FSE: 5YD) (“LAURION” or the “Corporation”) today announced that it is proposing to complete a flow-through private placement on a non-brokered basis (the “ Private Placement ”). The Corporation intends to raise up to approximately $ 1.5 million in gross proceeds by issuing up to approximately 14,285,714 “flow through” units (“ FT Units ”) at a price of $0.105 per FT Unit. Each FT Unit will consist of one common share of the Corporation to be issued as a “flow-through share” (as defined in subsection 66(15) of the Income Tax Act (Canada) (the “ Tax Act ”)) and one-half of one common share purchase warrant (each whole warrant, a “ Warrant ”). Each Warrant will entitle the holder thereof to acquire one non flow-through common share of the Corporation at a price of $0.18 per share for a period of 24 months from the date of issuance.

raw.title: Lithium Africa Announces Acceptance of Mining Right Application Covering 1,416 km2 at the Springbok Project
raw.text: Cape Town, South Africa--(Newsfile Corp. - November 25, 2026) - Lithium Africa Corp. (TSXV: LAF) (FSE: 6MQ) (OTCQB: LTAFF) ("Lithium Africa" or the "Company") announces that South Africa's Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources ("DMPR") has accepted the application lodged by Namli Exploration & Mining (Pty) Ltd ("Namli"), in which the Company holds a 70% interest, for a mining right (the "Mining Right") over 1,416 km² of the Springbok Project ("Springbok" or the "Project") in the Northern Cape (the "Application"). raw.text: HALIFAX, NS, Nov. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Isar Aerospace ("Isar") and Maritime Launch Services ("MLS") (TSX: MAXQ) (OTCQB: MAXQF) are taking the next step in advancing Canadian space capabilities with the transition of a dedicated launch complex at Spaceport Nova Scotia to Isar. raw.title: Micromem Closes Private Placement
raw.text: Toronto, Ontario and New York, New York--(Newsfile Corp. - November 24, 2026) - Micromem Technologies Inc. (CSE: MRM) (OTCQB: MMTIF) ("Micromem" or the "Company") announces closing of its non-brokered private placement (the "Financing") previously announced in its news release issued on November 13, 2026. Micromem raised gross proceeds of approximately C$162,883 by placing a total of 6,515,320 units at a price of C$0.025 per unit, each unit being comprised of one common share and one warrant exercisable at C$0.05 per share for a period of three years following the issuance date.
